verdict.rationale: Lambda's own docs list current-generation datacenter GPUs (B200, H100, GH200) for on-demand instances and clusters. Its pricing page also offers previous-generation A100 instances through the same self-serve flow, so the ML engineer can pick from both tiers. missing for 10: explicit H200 availability, documented per-GPU pricing showing the previous-generation options are cheaper, independent or hands-on corroboration of A100 availability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can choose from current-generation datacenter GPUs (H100/H200/B200 class) as well as cheaper previous-generation options

citations.quote: Deploy NVIDIA B200, H100, A100, or GH200 instances in minutes with self-serve, first-come access.
Available GPUs include the state-of-the-art NVIDIA HGX B200 GPU, NVIDIA GH200 Grace Hopper Superchip, and NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU
featuring 16 to 512 NVIDIA H100 or B200 SXM Tensor Core GPUs
